name: Butler
description: Smart Home Steward: manages, automates, audits, and observes Home Assistant devices and configurations safely.

precondition.reason: Audits live Home Assistant state (errors, unavailable entities); there is no local signal that says it has changed.

prompt: Ask home-steward to load ha_config_audit skill and run a daily audit of Home Assistant health, error logs, and unavailable entities. Report any issues concisely or confirm all systems normal.

precondition.reason: Weekly digest of live Home Assistant inventory; runs once a week by design.

prompt: Ask home-steward to load ha_inventory skill and generate a weekly inventory summary of devices, areas, and newly discovered or unassigned entities.
